title: ze_dnb_realms
description:
ZE_DNB_REALMS 

Welcome to my first CS2 map.
This is a Zombie ESCAPE map, it has to be played on a server and needs CS2FIX plugin to be installed to fully work.

 Introduction 
As many of you, I discovered Drum and Bass on CS:S Zombie Escape, thanks to Hannibal that brang us the best soundtrack ever to Mako Reactor. I became a huge Pendulum fanboy, and I started discovering other style of DnB.
Time passed, but I kept listenning to DnB in my car thinking "oh, this song would be insane for a ZE map", the levels were building up in my head, and that's how I ended up with this map. I gigantic playlist, with tons of songs I want you to discover! Of course my imagination can't build up something with every songs, but I'll do my best to show you different artists! 

 Stages 
For now, the map has 4 small stages, they are all played in a row (no checkpoints), but the final version of the map should work like ze_randomizer, contains 8 levels and an ending !

I hope you'll have fun, you can follow me on twitch if you want to discover MAPPING because I built this whole map streaming !
